children: climbed nearly 4% on Friday afternoon as Japan's Financial Services Agency said it would step up oversight of funding for artificial intelligence data centers.

The review comes as large banks and life insurers build greater exposure to data-center projects. Japan's regulator is assessing whether lenders have adequate safeguards for the financing of these developments, particularly projects tied to the United States.

The move puts added attention on companies supplying equipment for the expanding AI infrastructure market. Super Micro designs and sells server and storage systems used by data-center operators, cloud providers and corporate customers.

GuruFocus puts Super Micro's price-to-sales ratio at about 0.56, below its historical median. The company's cash-flow position limits the usefulness of earnings-based valuation measures such as the price-to-earnings ratio, according to the report.

GuruFocus also estimates the shares' GF Value at $86.72 and cites $15.4 million of insider selling over the past three months. Those figures offer additional context for investors tracking Super Micro as regulators increase scrutiny of AI-related financing.

title: What's Going On With Super Micro Stock Thursday
